info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Facility Building Maintenance-spec
info.description: The Facility Building Maintenance Management API enables organizations to efficiently manage maintenance operations for their facilities. This API allows users to create maintenance specifications, ensuring that all necessary details are captured for each building. Typical consumers include facility managers and maintenance teams who require a streamlined process for handling maintenance requests and tracking their status. By using this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and maintain high standards of facility upkeep.

post.summary: Create a new building maintenance request.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a new request for building maintenance services. The request will be processed to ensure timely addressing of the submitted issues.

requestBody.description: Request body containing details for building maintenance operations. This includes relevant information such as maintenance tasks, associated facilities, and operational parameters necessary to process the request effectively.

201.description: Resource successfully created, reflecting the new building maintenance entry.
